I would not have guessed so large and marvellous a flea existed. I am pleased it saw sense before I had to strike a killing blow.}}

The <b>Huge Flea</b> is an [[Enemies (Silksong)|enemy]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. It is a large [[Flea]] initially consumed with anger that is later tamed.<ref>Huge Flea Hunter's Journal entry: <i>"Oversized bug, briefly consumed by anger after its long time caged."</i></ref>

== Behaviour and Tactics ==
Huge Flea flies about the arena, charging horizontally at [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] in a straight line when it sees her. It charges until colliding with a wall or the environment, and briefly rolls back before preparing to charge again.

Huge Flea's charge and contact damage deals {{Damage|2}}.

== Location ==
The Huge Flea can initially be found in the [[Memorium]], trapped inside a cage much too small for it. Once the cage is broken, it will fight Hornet until defeated but not killed, and fly away.

After being rescued, Huge Flea joins the [[Flea Caravan]] and travels with them at [[the Marrow]], [[Greymoor]], [[Blasted Steps]] or [[Fleatopia]], depending on the amount of Fleas found. It can be seen flying or sleeping among the other fleas of the caravan.

== Trivia ==
* Does not respond to the [[Needolin]] in enemy form. When with the Caravan, it will respond much like the other rescued fleas.
* If the Huge Flea is among the first 5 Fleas rescued during <i>[[The Lost Fleas]]</i> [[wish]], it has a unique icon in the [[Tasks]] menu screen.
